art_direction: 浅薄荷长发女性穿行月洞门边，浅蓝连衣裙与绿意庭院构成轻盈东方画面。
composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 27-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Give her silver-green almond eyes, gently defined cheekbones, a refined chin, and a small confident smile. Her pale-mint hair is tied low with a simple cream ribbon. She wears an opaque powder-blue short-sleeved cotton midi dress with a modest rounded neckline and a relaxed waist, plus cream flats. She walks through the edge of a circular moon gate, one hand lightly holding the strap of a small crossbody bag and the other resting naturally beside her thigh. Keep the walking stride modest and balanced. Behind her, layered garden greenery, a few white hydrangeas, and a narrow stone path provide depth. Use powder blue, pale mint, warm stone, and leaf green, with bright diffuse daylight and delicate reflected highlights. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory heroine-v2-ninety/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Compressed contact sheet inspected: red-haired woman with plum vase, pale-green braid through moon gate, dark updo listening to rain chain, brunette crafting pressed-leaf bookmark, silver-haired woman on garden bridge, auburn braid watering bonsai. Adult anime figures, distinct facial designs and hands, opaque summer clothing, usable clock areas. No unwanted people, text or obvious anatomy errors.
